About Diary Desk

Welcome to Diary Desk

Your personal, secure, and feature-rich note-taking application built with modern web technologies.

Features

  • Rich Text Editor
  • File Attachments
  • Image Upload
  • Todo Lists
  • Search & Filter
  • Tag Organization
  • Dark Mode
  • Export Notes
  • Print Support
  • Undo/Redo
  • Note Statistics
  • Profile Management

Technology Stack

Frontend
  • React.js
  • Bootstrap 5
  • Font Awesome Icons
  • React Router
Backend
  • Node.js
  • Express.js
  • MongoDB
  • JWT Authentication

Security

Your notes are protected with industry-standard security measures:

  • JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication
  • Secure password hashing
  • HTTPS encryption
  • Input validation and sanitization
Version 2.0

Enhanced with advanced features

Quick Stats
50+
Features
100%
Free
Keyboard Shortcuts
Undo Ctrl + Z
Redo Ctrl + Shift + Z
Bold Ctrl + B
Italic Ctrl + I
Tips for Better Note-Taking
  • Use tags to organize your notes by topic, project, or priority
  • Take advantage of todo lists for actionable items
  • Attach relevant files and images to keep everything in one place
  • Use the search function to quickly find specific notes
  • Export important notes as backup copies
); }; export default About;
